notes: Hasbrouck Heights is a fully developed borough. DCA calculated prospective need 149; Borough adopted resolution January 14, 2025 accepting DCA's present need (8 units) but proposing 138 for prospective need based on land capacity correction (.078 ac developable vs DCA's 2.59 ac). Court order May 5, 2025 established 4th Round prospective need at 143 units. VLA: no new qualifying parcels in 4th Round; RDP = 0 (25% of 0 = 0 redevelopment obligation). Third Round RDP was 11 (satisfied with 9 base + 2 bonus credits). Prior Round obligation = 58 (RDP=0; 20 units addressed via Hasbrouck Heights Senior Housing and ARC group home). Third Round unmet need = 275; minus 14 surplus senior units = 261 remaining unmet need. Borough addresses unmet need via: (1) VFW Parcel AHO overlay (B 98 L:1.01, 26 total, 20% set-aside), (2) Industrial Avenue AHO overlay (~13 acres, 260 total, 20% set-aside), and (3) Borough-wide Mandatory Set-Aside Ordinance (20%, 5+ unit MF). 4th Round prospective need = 143 is in addition to the 261 unmet need. Candidate snapshot total_obligation = 157 (DCA's present 8 + DCA's prospective 149) — corrected to 151 (8 + 143 per court order). Candidate rdp = null — corrected to 0. Candidate site 'Longview Avenue (18 townhouses, 4 affordable)' is partially confirmed: it's the Third Round RDP component at B 162.02 L:1 & B 134.03 L:8, but the HEFSP table shows 4 total affordable units (not 18 total) — the 18-townhouse application from April 2024 LUB may be a separate action, while the HEFSP credits 4 units for this zone.
